# Top-40 glyph sequences by stability and universality (exploratory) — generated by harness/top40/score.py

Judges in the ranking pool: gemini31pro, gemini38flash, grok46, haiku45, opus55, qwen25-3b, sonnet55. Small local models (llama32-3b, mistral7b) are shown in the last column but do not enter the ranking.

Candidates: 117 survey sequences chosen by cross-surveyor concordance (harness/top40/candidates.py): batch a (0–63) was selected while a bug hid the grok-1 and sonnet-survey-3/4 records; batch b (64–116) adds every record with support from ≥ 2 of the 7 surveys not already covered. Surveyor counts are recomputed over all 7. Every adjacent rung was tested in both presentation orders with ⟂ and ≈ available; each whole set was reconstructed from 2 shuffles.

*Stability* = mean over judges of the share of rungs confirmed (both orders agree, running the same way along the surveyor's order). *Universality* = share of judges confirming ≥ 80% of rungs. *Floor* = the weakest judge's rung share. *Gestalt* = mean |τ| of whole-set reconstruction. Direction = how many judges read the written order as ascending (↑) vs descending (↓).
